title: Compare longer pseudotext against page-preserving and order-preserving controls
statement: Extend the frozen short-memory copy pilot to independently collected long pseudotext or a separately frozen edit-and-copy model. Assess within-page repetition and word association with illustrated sections jointly. Include whole-page section-label permutations, cyclic shifts, and global token shuffles. Fixed-length and illustration-triggered writing sessions can test whether vocabulary reuse tracks topics or merely the recent writing interval.
check: Publish the condition grid and seed list before measuring held-apart samples. Match line and page sizes. Compare all controls jointly on repetition and excess section association under each null. Report whether a joint match survives an order-preserving comparison, and report any dependence on hand, token support, page length or the number of surviving practice pages.
source: Daniel E. Gaskell and Claire L. Bowern, Gibberish after all? Voynichese is statistically similar to human-produced samples of meaningless text, 2022, §4, https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-3313/paper4.pdf . The illustrative pitshol/pitsholh report and discussion of copying from the current section motivate finite memory and periodic breaks. Copying exact tokens is a simplified model of those strategies.
methods: Use exactly the 615 certain eligible P-line loci shared by both public practice editions, arranged in original face order across 31 surviving pages. Reuse the observed slot counts in each edition. For each token, draw from pooled public-training unigram frequencies or copy a uniformly selected recent token with probability 0.33. Evaluate FIFO windows 0 (iid), 30, 180 and 720, and 180 with a reset every five retained pages regardless of actual section. Freeze the grid and seeds 201–216, with no fitting of per-section parameters. For local clustering, divide the within-page exact token-pair collision probability by the whole-sample collision probability. For across-section association use mutual information between token identity and IVTFF illustration section. Use 39 global token shuffles with fixed page and section sizes, 39 whole-page label permutations, and the complete 31-position cyclic orbit of section labels. Paired edition outcomes share the same underlying physical manuscript.
results_summary: Observed 5,185 ZL and 5,106 IT practice tokens. Within-page collision ratios are 1.919 and 1.940. The 30-token window can reach those values (4/16 ZL, 5/16 IT), and longer windows did not in this grid. Observed excess section mutual information over the whole-page label shuffles is 0.306/0.315 bits in ZL/IT, versus maximum 0.262/0.269 in the full tested control grid. The observed whole-page-label p is 0.025 in each edition but cyclic rank is 3/31 for each. Relative to global token shuffles, the source excess is 0.252/0.261 bits, while every 30-token control has a larger excess (ZL 0.274–0.337, IT 0.293–0.344). Thus some simple copy runs match both target levels versus token shuffle alone. Comparisons preserving page vocabulary and preserving order give weaker support for a joint match.
limitations: Whole-page label exchange changes section token totals and breaks the contiguous runs of section labels. Its IID control alone averages about 0.161 bits of apparent excess in both editions, so judge source-control contrasts under the same layout and show token and cyclic comparisons as well. Cyclic label shifts preserve the sequence of section labels but can also change token totals, and the nominal p is coarse. The practice subset is sparse and may confound section, total token counts, Currier variety and hand. Runs reuse a manuscript-trained unigram and measure copy alone. The outcomes do not establish how long human sessions behave and do not rule out mutation or other drift schedules.
reproduction: Save the embedded Python as measure.py. Run from the project checkout with PYTHONPATH=. python3 /path/to/measure.py. The script uses the pinned public corpus and writes /tmp/fleet-sol-long-session.json.
